data.name: Hotel Swan's Cay
data.description:
This casual hotel on a residential street is a 6-minute walk from Bocas del Toro International Airport, an 8-minute walk from the ferry terminal and 2 km from Istmito Beach.
The straightforward rooms sleeping up to 6 people have complimentary Wi-Fi, flat-screen TVs and minifridges, in addition to safes.
Amenities include a relaxed restaurant, and an outdoor pool with a kids' section. Breakfast and an airport shuttle are available.
